proof_body:
by
  intro x h k hk
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hk
  generalize Real.sqrt k = s at hs ⊢
  constructor
  · intro h1
    have h2 : (x - h - s) * (x - h + s) = 0 := by linear_combination h1 - hs
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h2 with h3 | h3
    · left
      linarith
    · right
      linarith
  · rintro (h1 | h1)
    · rw [h1]
      linear_combination hs
    · rw [h1]
      linear_combination hs
target_source: ∀ (x h k : ℝ), 0 ≤ k → ((x - h) ^ 2 = k ↔ x = h + Real.sqrt k ∨ x = h - Real.sqrt k)
